explanation.fa: I do not think we have met before راه نرم گفتن «فکر نمی‌کنم قبلاً آشنا شده باشیم» است. not کنار do می‌آید. گوینده با I think نشان می‌دهد نظر خودش را می‌گوید، نه یک واقعیت قطعی.
explanation.en: I do not think we have met before gently says the speakers probably have not met. Not goes with do. I think presents the speaker’s view, not a certain fact.

translation.fa: سلام، فکر نمی‌کنم قبلاً با هم آشنا شده باشیم.
translation.en: Hello, I do not think we have met before.

takeaway.en: Do not think means I think this is not so.

explanation.en: Have met is about meeting before now. Have worked together for two years connects earlier work with now. Already says something has happened before this moment.

title.en: Experience and time up to now

rows.text: We have worked together for two years

rows.fa: دو سال است با هم کار می‌کنیم

rows.text: I have already met some people

rows.fa: تا الان با چند نفر آشنا شده‌ام

explanation.fa: How do you know the host? دربارهٔ رابطه با میزبان است. Are you enjoying the evening? دربارهٔ لذت بردن همین امشب است؛ are پیش از you و enjoying با ing آمده است.
explanation.en: How do you know the host? asks about a connection. Are you enjoying the evening? asks about this evening now; are comes before you, with enjoying ending in ing.

example.text: That is a long time, are you enjoying the evening so far?

translation.fa: زمان زیادی است؛ تا اینجا از امشب لذت می‌بری؟
translation.en: That is a long time, are you enjoying the evening so far?

takeaway.fa: do you know برای شناختن؛ are you enjoying برای همین تجربه.
takeaway.en: Do you know asks about a connection; are you enjoying asks about now.

rows.text: how do you know the host?

title.fa: چند نفر، خیلی و هر دو

explanation.fa: some people یعنی چند نفر. people خودش معنی چند نفر دارد و peoples لازم نیست. both می‌گوید دو چیز با هم خوب‌اند: موسیقی و غذا. Very much جواب کوتاهِ «خیلی لذت می‌برم» است.
explanation.en: Some people means several people; people already means more than one person. Both includes the music and the food. Very much is a short answer meaning I am enjoying it a lot.

example.text: Very much, the music and the food are both excellent.

translation.fa: خیلی زیاد؛ هم موسیقی و هم غذا عالی‌اند.
translation.en: Very much, the music and the food are both excellent.

takeaway.fa: both یعنی هر دو، نه فقط یکی.
takeaway.en: Both means the two, not just one.

title.fa: چند نفر، خیلی و هر دو

rows.text: the music and the food are both excellent

rows.fa: هم موسیقی و هم غذا عالی‌اند

rows.text: understood: I enjoy it very much

explanation.fa: Perhaps we can exchange contact information یک پیشنهاد است؛ perhaps یعنی شاید و can یعنی می‌توانیم. I would like to stay in touch هم مؤدبانه‌تر از I want است. پس از would like، to و کار می‌آید.
explanation.en: Perhaps we can exchange contact information is a gentle suggestion. Perhaps means maybe. I would like is more polite than I want; follow it with to and the action.

example.text: That would be nice, I would like to stay in touch.

translation.fa: خوب می‌شود؛ دوست دارم در ارتباط بمانیم.
translation.en: That would be nice, I would like to stay in touch.

takeaway.fa: would like to + کار، خواسته را مؤدبانه می‌گوید.
takeaway.en: Would like to + action expresses a polite wish.

rows.text: Perhaps we can exchange contact information

rows.fa: شاید اطلاعات تماس را ردوبدل کنیم

rows.text: I would like to stay in touch
would like + to stay in touch

explanation.fa: before the party ends یعنی قبل از تمام شدن مهمانی. در این بخش از ends استفاده شده، نه will end. برای قول نوشتن فردا، I will write آمده است. to you هم دریافت‌کنندهٔ نوشته را می‌گوید.
explanation.en: Before the party ends means earlier than the end. Use ends in this part, not will end. I will write gives a promise for tomorrow; to you names the receiver.

example.text: Here is my card, and I will write to you tomorrow.

translation.fa: این کارت من است و فردا برایت می‌نویسم.
translation.en: Here is my card, and I will write to you tomorrow.

takeaway.fa: before + جمله، زمان را مشخص می‌کند.
takeaway.en: Before + a statement gives the time.

rows.text: I will write to you tomorrow

title.fa: معرفی خود و نشان دادن کارت

explanation.fa: I am Arman نام را می‌گوید و a friend of the host رابطه را اضافه می‌کند. Here is my card یعنی «این کارت من است». my نشان می‌دهد کارت مال چه کسی است.
explanation.en: I am Arman gives a name; a friend of the host adds the relationship. Here is my card presents the card. My says whose card it is.

example.text: That is right, I am Arman, a friend of the host.

translation.fa: درست است؛ من آرمان هستم، از دوستان میزبان.
translation.en: That is right, I am Arman, a friend of the host.

takeaway.fa: Here is برای دادن یا نشان دادن چیزی مفید است.
takeaway.en: Here is is useful when presenting something.

title.fa: معرفی خود و نشان دادن کارت

rows.text: I am Arman, a friend of the host

context.fa: سلام برای شروع آشنایی در مهمانی.
context.en: A greeting to start getting acquainted at a party.

example.text: Hello, I do not think we have met before.

translation.fa: سلام، فکر نمی‌کنم قبلاً با هم آشنا شده باشیم.
translation.en: Hello, I do not think we have met before.

phrases.text: I do not think we have met before

pronunciation.faReading: آی دو نات ثینک وی هَو مِت بی‌فور
pronunciation.ipa: /aɪ du nɑt θɪŋk wi hæv mɛt bɪˈfɔr/

meaning.fa: فکر نمی‌کنم قبلاً آشنا شده باشیم
meaning.en: I do not think we have met before

context.fa: شروعی مؤدبانه با کسی که احتمالاً تازه می‌بینیم.
context.en: A polite opening with someone who is probably new to us.

example.text: Hello, I do not think we have met before.

translation.fa: سلام، فکر نمی‌کنم قبلاً با هم آشنا شده باشیم.
translation.en: Hello, I do not think we have met before.

context.fa: آرمان گفتهٔ نگار را تأیید می‌کند.

example.text: That is right, I am Arman, a friend of the host.

translation.fa: درست است؛ من آرمان هستم، از دوستان میزبان.
translation.en: That is right, I am Arman, a friend of the host.

context.fa: تعریف از مهمانی برای ادامهٔ یک صحبت دوستانه.
context.en: A compliment about the party that keeps the conversation going.

example.text: I am Nigar, it is a lovely party, how do you know the host?

translation.fa: من نگارم؛ مهمانی دلپذیری است. میزبان را از کجا می‌شناسی؟
translation.en: I am Nigar, it is a lovely party, how do you know the host?

context.fa: جواب کوتاه به پرسش لذت بردن از امشب.
context.en: A short answer about enjoying the evening.

example.text: Very much, the music and the food are both excellent.

translation.fa: خیلی زیاد؛ هم موسیقی و هم غذا عالی‌اند.
translation.en: Very much, the music and the food are both excellent.

context.fa: نگار نظر مثبت دربارهٔ غذا و موسیقی را می‌پذیرد.
context.en: Nigar shares the positive opinion of the food and music.

example.text: I agree, and I have already met some very interesting people here.

translation.fa: موافقم و تا همین حالا با چند آدم خیلی جالب اینجا آشنا شده‌ام.
translation.en: I agree, and I have already met some very interesting people here.

context.fa: برای ادامهٔ ارتباط پس از مهمانی؛ exchange یعنی هر دو طرف چیزی می‌دهند.
context.en: A way to continue contact after the party; exchange involves both giving and receiving.

example.text: Perhaps we can exchange contact information before the party ends.

translation.fa: شاید بتوانیم قبل از تمام شدن مهمانی اطلاعات تماسمان را ردوبدل کنیم.
translation.en: Perhaps we can exchange contact information before the party ends.

context.fa: پیشنهاد ردوبدل‌کردن اطلاعات را با لحن نرم قبول می‌کند.
context.en: Gently accepts the suggestion to exchange details.

example.text: That would be nice, I would like to stay in touch.

translation.fa: خوب می‌شود؛ دوست دارم در ارتباط بمانیم.
translation.en: That would be nice, I would like to stay in touch.

context.fa: به معنی ادامهٔ ارتباط است، نه لمس کردن.
context.en: Means continuing communication, not physical touching.

example.text: That would be nice, I would like to stay in touch.

translation.fa: خوب می‌شود؛ دوست دارم در ارتباط بمانیم.
translation.en: That would be nice, I would like to stay in touch.

context.fa: هنگام دادن کارت تماس به طرف مقابل.
context.en: Used when handing someone a contact card.

example.text: Here is my card, and I will write to you tomorrow.

translation.fa: این کارت من است و فردا برایت می‌نویسم.
translation.en: Here is my card, and I will write to you tomorrow.

prompt.fa: دو نفر در حال انجام چه کاری‌اند؟

explanation.fa: نگار می‌گوید احتمالاً قبلاً آشنا نشده‌اند و از مهمانی صحبت می‌کند.
explanation.en: Nigar says they probably have not met before and mentions the party.

prompt.fa: آرمان میزبان را از چه راهی می‌شناسد؟
prompt.en: How does Arman know the host?

explanation.fa: آرمان می‌گوید روی یک پروژه با هم کار کرده‌اند.
explanation.en: Arman says they have worked together on a project.

prompt.en: How long have they worked together?

prompt.fa: آرمان برای ادامهٔ ارتباط چه چیزی می‌دهد؟
prompt.en: What does Arman give to help them keep in contact?

explanation.fa: در پایان آرمان می‌گوید Here is my card.
explanation.en: At the end Arman says Here is my card.

prompt.fa: آرمان چه زمانی می‌خواهد برای نگار بنویسد؟
prompt.en: When does Arman plan to write to Nigar?

explanation.fa: آرمان می‌گوید I will write to you tomorrow.
explanation.en: Arman says I will write to you tomorrow.
